heldPainting.qualification: Actual nine-primitive wall/cap network; painting path remains outside protected support. Per-run complete bank hashes verify Undo/Redo and opposing bank isolation. Native dispatch can coalesce. Pixel observation and release-coherence timings are separate; neither is a per-input latency guarantee.
heldPainting.memoryExclusions: Terrain histories, GPU/programs, transient arrays, workers, JS objects and process memory excluded from the counted typed-buffer subtotal. Raw cases retain measured JS heap and renderer statistics.
heldPainting.startupQualification: Scripted New World and connection preparation include UI automation, terrain/display preparation and driver-dependent first-use shader work. Raw case timings are preserved without claiming isolated engine/compile latency.

formatContract: v11 featureless; v12 holes-only in objects and every journal state; v13 full. Deletion retains minimum version/history. Upgrades require same immutable World geometry/IDs/resolution.
geometry: Own wall/cap portal normal and rim clearance; whole material ball/capsule certificates; middle cap thickness/radius staging; bounded vertical/angular routes. No cube/sphere containment or sampled path approximation.
limits: Reference-shell zero-ground support, protected on both terrain banks.
48 total cutting primitives; eight networks; 128 links; 256 KiB connection words. Conservative overlap, precision, rim and containment restrictions.
Fitted Inside and Surface map show reference markers; supported physical views show real cut volume.
Guided centerlines only; no free-flight collision or displaced mountain/seabed excavation.
developmentCorrections: Imported segments below the precision floor were initially accepted despite node floors. Negative unit reproduced this; every segment now validates the same floor. All 1268 final numerical tests passed.

New link-only browser test initially waited for controls after Open Map closed its tool panel. Corrected the test to reopen tools; all four desktop/mobile GPU/Canvas cases passed. No product history change was needed.
